name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NonLattice.abelian_path_rectangle
title: Abelian path sums satisfy the rectangle identity: any commutative branching-program labelling is affine in the witness bits
statement: Let G be an additive commutative group, var : Fin L -> Fin n a reading order and f_j : Bool -> G the labels of step j. For P(v) = sum_j f_j(v(var j)), any w and distinct positions i != k, P(w[i:=0,k:=0]) + P(w[i:=1,k:=1]) = P(w[i:=0,k:=1]) + P(w[i:=1,k:=0]).
